forum.content_text:
There is a problem with saving assembler source files when the ***C/C++ > Editor > Save Action > Format source code***option is enabled:

As a result, the file is not saved, and when it is just created, there is no file at all. It's quite irritating, especially because this is quite an old bug and no one has resolved it yet.
